Voyager 1 Crosses Historic One Light-Day Threshold On November 18, 2026, at 2:16 a.m. PST (10:16 UTC), NASA’s Voyager 1 spacecraft reached a distance of exactly one light-day from Earth. After traveling across interplanetary and interstellar space for more than 49 years following its September 1977 launch, the probe reached a physical displacement of approximately 16.1 billion miles (25.9 billion kilometers), or roughly 173.14 Astronomical Units (AU). At this distance, radio signals propagating at light speed require exactly 24 hours to travel one way between ground tracking stations and the probe. Flight controllers at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) in Pasadena, California, managed by Caltech, confirmed the passage using radio carrier tracking via the Deep Space Network. Because light travel time equals Earth’s 24-hour day, commands sent to the spacecraft require 48 hours for round-trip verification. clusters.title: Prayagraj to develop three bus terminals on city outskirts to ease traffic congestion
also: Prayagraj will have three new bus terminals to ease traffic congestion
clusters.text: Prayagraj: In a major move to ease traffic congestion in Prayagraj, three new inter-district bus terminals will be developed on the city’s outskirts to stop outstation buses from entering congested areas. The terminals will come up at Kanihar for buses from the Varanasi side, near Leprosy Crossing for those arriving from Chitrakoot and Rewa Road, and at Phaphamau for buses from the Lucknow side.The decision was taken at a meeting chaired by Divisional Commissioner Dr Lokesh M with Municipal Commissioner Sai Teja and Prayagraj Development Authority vice-chairman Rishiraj.The Municipal Corporation has already identified land at all three locations and will send a proposal to the Roadways for further action. City bus services will connect the new terminals with different parts of Prayagraj, allowing passengers to reach the city without inter-district buses entering its congested roads.“We have already identified the land at all these three places and have asked UPSRTC to tell us their requirement so that the desired measurement of land can be provided to them for operating the bus stations at the respective points,” said Municipal Commissioner Sai Teja.The meeting also decided to undertake the restoration and beautification of historic Malviya Park, popularly known as Minto Park. The Municipal Corporation will coordinate with the Forest Department and the divisional forest officer for the park’s renovation, maintenance and better management. The civic body will also ensure regular upkeep after the beautification work.Three labour hubs are being developed at Rajapur, Naini and Rambagh to provide workers with designated spaces and basic facilities. Construction at Rajapur is progressing and the facility is targeted to be opened by the end of this month. The hubs are also intended to prevent unplanned gatherings of workers at different locations across the city.To control dust pollution and improve the Air Quality Index (AQI), the Municipal Corporation will launch a special drive to remove accumulated soil and garbage from roadsides. Regular cleaning and waste lifting will be undertaken to prevent dust from being dispersed by passing vehicles.Dr Lokesh directed the concerned officials to implement all decisions within fixed timelines, with priority to measures aimed at easing traffic, improving cleanliness, controlling pollution and strengthening urban facilities.
